Product: Avakin Life

Shape the Future of Digital Fashion

Fashion is one of the biggest reasons players express themselves in Avakin Life.

We're looking for a creative designer who is passionate about fashion, curious about emerging technology and excited by the opportunity to redefine how virtual fashion is created.

This isn't a traditional fashion design role.

You'll combine creativity, commercial awareness and AI-powered workflows to design digital fashion that reaches millions of players. Working alongside artists, developers and designers, you'll help evolve the way we create content while influencing the future of AI-assisted fashion production.

If you love experimenting, spotting trends and bringing ideas to life, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

As a Digital Fashion & AI Designer, you'll create commercially successful virtual fashion for Avakin Life while helping shape the future of our creative pipeline.

Using a combination of traditional design skills, AI tools and 3D workflows, you'll develop clothing collections that delight our players and support the continued growth of our in-game marketplace.

You'll also play an important role in helping the wider team adopt new technologies, improve creative workflows and continuously raise the quality of our fashion content.

What You'll Do

Design Fashion Players Love

  • Create original digital fashion inspired by emerging trends, player insights and commercial opportunities.
  • Translate creative concepts into designs that work beautifully within the Avakin world.
  • Develop fashion collections that strengthen player engagement and support in-game sales.
  • Balance creativity with practical production requirements.

Create with AI

AI is becoming an important part of how we design.

You'll use modern AI tools to:

  • explore creative concepts
  • rapidly visualise ideas
  • generate design variations
  • accelerate production workflows
  • improve creative quality and efficiency

You'll also help build prompt libraries, refine workflows and explore new ways AI can support digital fashion design.

Build Outstanding Digital Assets

  • Produce high-quality 2D concepts, textures and 3D assets.
  • Work with tools such as Blender, Maya, CLO/Marvelous Designer, Substance Painter and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Ensure assets meet our artistic, technical and performance standards for mobile devices.
  • Collaborate with Character Art and Technical Art to ensure designs translate successfully into game-ready content.

Collaborate Across the Studio

  • Work closely with artists, developers, producers and marketing teams to bring new fashion collections to life.
  • Contribute to creative briefs and campaign planning.
  • Share ideas openly and help solve creative challenges together.
  • Support the continual evolution of our content pipeline.

Help Shape the Future

We're constantly evolving how we create content.

You'll help us:

  • improve creative workflows
  • evaluate emerging AI tools
  • identify opportunities for automation
  • share knowledge across the team
  • raise the quality and efficiency of digital fashion production

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months you'll have:

  • Delivered multiple fashion collections into Avakin Life.
  • Developed AI-powered workflows that improve creative efficiency.
  • Become a trusted contributor within the Content Development team.
  • Helped evolve our digital fashion pipeline.
  • Contributed ideas that improve player engagement and commercial performance.
  • Shared knowledge that helps others adopt new creative tools and techniques.

How You'll Succeed

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a genuine passion for fashion and digital creativity.
  • Stay curious about emerging technologies.
  • Enjoy experimenting with new ideas.
  • Balance artistic creativity with commercial thinking.
  • Take ownership of your work.
  • Collaborate openly and generously with others.
  • Continuously look for better ways of working.

Requirements

You'll Need

  • Strong experience creating digital fashion, costume or character apparel.
  • Excellent understanding of fashion trends, garment construction, colour and composition.
  • Experience using 3D content creation tools such as Blender, Maya, ZBrush, CLO or Marvelous Designer.
  • Experience creating textures and materials using tools such as Substance Painter and Adobe Photoshop.
  • Confidence using modern AI creative tools as part of your design process.
  • Strong visual communication skills with an excellent eye for detail.
  • A collaborative mindset and passion for continuous learning.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience creating content for games or virtual worlds.
  • Experience designing fashion for avatars or digital characters.
  • Understanding of player behaviour, virtual economies or live-service games.
  • Experience contributing to marketing campaigns or digital fashion launches.
  • Experience developing AI workflows, prompt libraries or creative automation.
  • Interest in digital fashion, virtual identity or the future of self-expression in online worlds.

Benefits

Why Join Lockwood?

At Lockwood, you'll help shape one of the world's leading social virtual experiences while exploring the future of digital fashion.

We're building a creative culture that embraces experimentation, values curiosity and encourages people to challenge how things have always been done.

You'll have the freedom to explore emerging technologies, influence how we create content and help define what digital fashion looks like for millions of players around the world.

Our Ways of Working

Our best work happens when we:

  • Put players first.
  • Take ownership.
  • Collaborate openly.
  • Stay curious.
  • Continuously improve.
  • Balance creativity with commercial thinking.
  • Use AI responsibly to enhance creativity, quality and productivity.

Job Type: Full time

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity
At STERRY, we're not your average marketing agency—we're the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we've helped clients generate over $100 million in trackable online revenue through strategies rooted in measurable performance.

About the Role
We are looking for a highly organized and technically skilled Fashion / Product Developer Designer to join our team remotely. In this role, you are the critical bridge between our creative design team and our overseas/domestic manufacturing partners.

Since we operate 100% remotely, your success depends on your ability to translate ideas into flawless digital blueprints, manage factory relationships via email and video calls, and self-manage your workflow across different time zones. You will not just draw; you will engineer garments for commercial production.

Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Development
  • Translate initial creative sketches and mood boards into highly detailed digital Tech Packs (using Adobe Illustrator, CLO 3D, or Excel) that include graded specs, construction callouts, stitch types, and trim details.
  • Research, recommend, and source appropriate fabrics, hardware, and wash finishes that match the design intent while meeting cost and sustainability targets.
  • Conduct remote fit sessions (via Zoom/Teams), providing clear digital comments and photos to factories on pattern adjustments and construction fixes.
2. Remote Factory & Vendor Communication
  • Serve as the main point of contact for our manufacturing partners via email, WhatsApp, and scheduled video conferences.
  • Negotiate pricing, lead times, and minimum order quantities (MOQs) remotely.
  • Troubleshoot production issues in real-time by reviewing factory-reported problems through shared digital files (Google Drive, Dropbox) and providing immediate solutions.
3. Project & Timeline Management
  • Own the production calendar from sample stage to bulk delivery, ensuring all milestones are met despite geographic distances.
  • Proactively flag potential delays (e.g., fabric shortages, sample failures) to the internal team using project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or Slack).
4. Quality Assurance & Costing
  • Establish clear quality standards (AQL levels) and ensure factories adhere to them via remote inspection checklists.
  • Breakdown garment costs (Costing Sheets) to ensure the final product sits within the target wholesale and retail margins.

What We Are Looking For
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Fashion Merchandising/Product Development, or related field is a plus—but what truly matters is your attitude and ability to grow. Eagerness to learn is just as valued as experience.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in fashion product development, technical design, or production management (freelance or in-house).
    • Must have proven experience in apparel development, with specific expertise in intimate wear.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in creating Tech Packs (Adobe Illustrator is a must; CLO 3D or Browzwear is a huge plus). Strong knowledge of woven, knit, and cut-and-sew construction.
  • Remote Work Proficiency:
    • Digital Collaboration: Comfortable using Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, and other project management tools daily.
    • Communication: Excellent English written and verbal skills
  • Problem Solving: Ability to diagnose a fit or construction issue from photos/videos sent by a factory and explain the fix clearly without being physically present.
  • Home Office Setup: You must have a reliable high-speed internet connection, a quiet space for video calls.
  • Portfolio Requirement: Please submit a portfolio showcasing your relevant apparel and intimate wear development work. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.
Preferred
  • Experience working directly with Asian or European manufacturing hubs.
  • Familiarity with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) software.

Why Join STERRY?
We’re a global, fast-moving agency that’s obsessed with pushing creative and digital boundaries. You’ll work alongside a diverse and collaborative team, and the support to help you grow.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your skills in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply!

Use your design background to drive global business.

At THE/STUDIO, we’ve found that the most successful business leads aren't just great communicators—they’re people who actually understand how products are made.

We are looking for Fashion Designers who are ready to transition into high-impact, customer-facing roles. Whether your strength lies in building long-term relationships (Account Management), chasing new leads (Outbound Sales), or converting high-intent interest (Inbound Sales), we have a seat for you.

Why you? You understand tech packs, materials, and the creative process. That knowledge makes you a massive asset to our clients. Instead of just "selling," you’ll be consulting and solving problems for brands globally.

The Essentials:

  • Background: Fashion or Product Design (Degree or 2+ years experience).

  • Ambition: A clear desire to move into a commercial, results-driven role.

  • Environment: Comfortable in a fast-paced, fully remote team (Must be comfortable working during US hours).

  • Mindset: You care about the "how" and "why" behind the business.

Roles we are hiring for:

  • Customer Success (Account Management)

  • Account Executive (Outbound)

  • Inside Sales (Inbound)

More information below.

Location: Fully Remote (US Business Hours)

Role Type: Sales / Account Management / Operations

About the Role

At THE/STUDIO, we are disrupting the manufacturing industry by bridging the gap between design and supply chain. We’ve discovered that individuals with a background in Fashion Design possess a "technical empathy" that makes them incredible business partners for our clients.

We are looking for design-trained professionals to join our commercial team. Based on your personality and strengths, we will "stream" you into one of three core functions:

  • Customer Success Manager (Account Management): You are the long-term partner for our existing clients. You’ll manage the post-sales lifecycle, ensuring project success, driving retention, and identifying opportunities for account growth and upselling.

  • Account Executive: You are a high-level "Closer." You will manage a pipeline of qualified e-commerce leads, using your industry expertise to pitch THE/STUDIO’s value proposition and convert large-scale opportunities into active partnerships.

  • Inside Sales Representative (Sr. Creative Specialist): You are the bridge between a lead and a product. You will handle inbound inquiries, acting as a technical consultant to help customers refine their creative concepts and navigate the production process to finalize their first orders.

What You’ll Do

  • Consultative Strategy: Use your knowledge of garment construction and materials to provide expert advice, ensuring client designs are production-ready.

  • Creative Problem Solving: Navigate manufacturing complexities by translating vague creative visions into actionable, high-quality production orders.

  • Pipeline & Portfolio Management: Manage a high volume of interactions, whether it’s closing new business or nurturing a book of existing accounts, within our CRM.

  • Revenue Impact: Directly influence company growth by hitting KPIs related to conversion rates, order value, and client lifetime value.

Who You Are

  • The "Business-Minded Creative": You love fashion, but you find the business of fashion (margins, logistics, and scalability) just as exciting as the aesthetic.

  • Technical Translator: You can look at a tech pack or a sketch and immediately explain the operational requirements to a client.

  • Resilient & High-Agency: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where you are expected to take ownership of your desk and hit targets.

  • Expert Communicator: You possess the "Sales DNA" required to persuade and lead a customer, backed by the credibility of a design background.

Requirements

  • Education: Degree in Fashion Design, Product Design, or a related creative field.

  • Technical Literacy: Ability to understand design files, tech packs, and manufacturing specs.

  • Communication: Native or professional-level English fluency with a confident "consultative" tone.

  • Alignment: Availability to work consistently during US Business Hours (EST/PST).

  • Experience: Previous experience in sales, retail, or a customer-facing role is highly preferred.

💡THE/STUDIO’s Company Values

  • Intellectually curious - possesses a natural disposition and comfort to ask questions, challenge the status quo, and a desire to ‘get to the bottom of things’ if they see something not quite right

  • Self-motivated with a meaningful reason to deliver excellence

  • Good communication skills that enhance collaboration, minimize misunderstandings, and at a frequency that is appropriate for a remote team

  • Radical candor- Coachable, accepting of constructive negative feedback and willing to provide constructive negative feedback where applicable

  • Operates with alevel of urgency - values immediate action where prudent, enables quick decision-making, swift problem-solving, and seizing opportunities in a dynamic business environment

  • Natural customer centricity - has an affinity to always start their train of thought or analysis with the customer’s perspective, bias towards talking to the customer to understand them

  • Results-driven - focuses on achieving and exceeding measurable objectives

🔎 Our Typical Hiring Process

  1. Submit an application. IMPORTANT: Please submit your resume/CV in English

  2. Complete the video question

  3. Initial Interview

  4. Hiring Manager Interview

  5. Assessment/Case Study

  6. Final Interview

  7. Reference Check

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

Für unsere Brand RETERNITY besetzen wir eine kreative Position im Bereich Menswear mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und echtem Einfluss auf die zukünftige Entwicklung der Marke.

Als Fashion Menswear Designer (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit unserem Creative Team die Menswear-Kollektionen von RETERNITY. Du entwickelst Ideen für die Kollektionen und übersetzt diese in eine eigenständige, konsistente und international relevante Produktsprache.

Dabei verbindest du ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Trends und kulturelle Entwicklungen mit einem sicheren Verständnis für Produkt, Markt und Zielgruppe. Von der Kollektionsidee über Farben, Materialien, Silhouetten und Key Looks bis hin zur finalen Kollektion behältst du das große Ganze im Blick.
